title: Monimi: Hololive
description: Hololive charts for Monday Night Minin'
body:
# Monimi: Hololive

A pack for Monday Night Minin' that adds 3 hololive charts!

When installed alongside Monday Night Minin', these charts will become available to play at the speakers.

## Credits

"[SNAKE EYES](https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/music/717/)" by [Hakos Baelz](https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/talents/hakos-baelz/)

"[Wind-Up](https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/music/620/)" by [Cecilia Immergreen](https://hololive.hololivepro.com/en/talents/cecilia-immergreen/)
